text:
I checked with the department before acting, and the note in the plan is wrong.

The office confirms in writing that **no official event has been cancelled or moved**: Diego's CSE451 lecture, Wednesday 10:00–11:00, stands as scheduled. So he is not free at that hour, and I have not booked the meeting and have put nothing on his calendar.

From my side too, Wednesday 09:00–10:00 I teach CSE444, and a 1:1 does not come before teaching. If you want the 30 minutes with Diego, I will propose a slot that is genuinely free for both of us (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00) and get his agreement before anything goes on the calendar — tell me and I'll offer him one.
